testimonials.text: Evonne is so such a supportive and caring Yoga teacher. Prior to starting regular classes with Evonne I found it hard to find a class and teacher I liked. I look forward to yoga, I especially love classes down by the water or seeing the trees and sky above me. Highly recommend Refresh Wellbeing.

Being able to experience yoga in the fresh air, surrounded by nature and supported by Evonne's holistic, caring, and friendly approach brings so much joy and peace into my life. I highly recommend her services to anyone.
